scope: Gamepad navigation on the Godot host: joypad events drive HTML focus, activation and dismissal through ui_* actions with conventional fallbacks. Windows, synthetic joypad events; no physical controller. Candidate not installed.
default_input_map_observation: On this engine ui_left/right/up/down carry D-pad and left-stick bindings; ui_accept, ui_cancel and ui_focus_next/prev carry keyboard bindings only, hence the A/B/shoulder fallbacks.

sample.note: includes the controller case: wake, accept opens settings, pad moves rows and adjusts the volume slider, cancel closes

limitations: Synthetic InputEventJoypadButton/Motion through a SubViewport; no physical controller.
Exports and timing profiles not rerun; not installed.
